notes.title: Pain Party Patch 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
This is the first major patch that adds a new map and some much need quality of life improvements.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new map Body Brawl for single player.
[*] Added new map Body Brawl for multiplayer.
[*] Added new feature "coyote time" (This means that you can jump once within 30 milliseconds after walking/running off a ledge. Should make platforming a lot more forgiving).
[*] Added target indicators for all long range enemies. You should no longer get caught off guard by a ranged enemy off screen.
[*] Added two in game maps for easier orientation. 
[/list]

New map Body Brawl
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40882028/57fe07cab79fb5a01a65fb367106cfd9c61a7471.png[/img]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Re-balanced Painful Path, making the conveyor belt slower.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where you could get soft locked on a launch pad when getting hit.
[*] Fixed issue where sometime particle effects would spawn twice.
[*] Fixed issue where if you stand too long on the final boss hands he would stop attacking altogether. 
[*] Fixed a few typos.
[/list]

Cheers
Icehelm

notes.title: Pain Party Hotfix 7
notes.content:
Hotfix for Pain Party resolving a major controller rebind issue.

Rebinding your movement on a controller could affect the character movement, making the game unplayable on a controller. This has now been solved with a reset input button in the controller menu. If you encountered this bug you should use the reset to default button

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40882028/80eff1e07c4a2593d38f78bc9cb2f9bc3f4236fe.jpg[/img]

The option for changing axis input has now been removed and instead an alt controller option has been added in setting for people who want to switch analog stick movement.

The mouse sensitivity has also been tied to controller sensitivity, this was a highly requested feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40882028/a634aae2a812b51ef44fb091c1e0e52c23e332a6.jpg[/img]

I'm sorry for any inconvenience this might have caused you.

Cheers
Icehelm

notes.title: Pain Party Hotfix 4
notes.content:

[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]

[*] Doomba 9000 now has more telegraphed attacks and a small cool down after each attack. His speed boost between phases has been decreased as well
[*] Pirate Peril has been re-balanced to make the starting section less tedious
[*] Toxic reduction rate when not standing in toxic has been reduced. It will now take longer for the meter to go down

[*] Rotation of the laser rotator in the world map has been decreased to make it easier to gain access to the level mechanical madness

[/list]

Cheers
Icehelm

[*] Added support for 24 players
[*] Added two new weapons, the plasma cannon and time rifle
[*] Added launch pads on two of the maps
[*] Added hover platform
[*] Added a new retro filter called Retro Plus
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40882028/bb72f2560a7027d59f41d9a62f4346bd9892ea46.jpg[/img]

Changes
[list]
[*] All levels have been tweaked to for better balance and more fun.
[*] Charged jumps now drain different amount of stamina depending on charge level.
[*] Full jump charge now drains 35 points of stamina instead of 30
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Various geometry and collision box fixes
[*] You no longer get stuck in a fall state when standing on a enemy
[*] Fixed bug on the level with the dancing NPCs that would only allow 4 players in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed lasers going through the geometry on some levels
[/list]

Join the discord for feedback/bug reports or just hitting up multiplayer with other people.

The playtest has now been running a bit over a week now and during this time there has been some valuable feedback from players. 

So without further ado, here are some changes and fixes to the playtest.

Additions
[list]
[*] Added two single player maps
[*] Added a third multiplayer map
[*] Added level up booth in the training area
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*] The blast radius from explosions have been reduced to fit the size of the special effect
[*] Bombs will no longer explode if you are too close
[*] Fixed the issue where you could fly outside the walls of the desert level
[*] Removed the airplanes from the desert level to make the level a bit easier
[*] Fixed micro jumps (removed the ability to charge the jump while being airborne)
[/list]

Join the discord for feedback/bug reports or just hitting up multiplayer with other people.
